title: The higher-order content fixes what it is like

statements.text: When the higher-order thought and its target diverge, what it is like for one follows the higher-order thought. With a sensation of red and a higher-order thought that one has a sensation of green, what it is like is seeing green, while the red sensation still shows up in priming.

sources.quote: If one has a sensation of red and a distinct HOT that one has a sensation of green, the sensation of red may nonetheless be detectable by various priming effects. But what it will be like for one is that one has a sensation of green.
